pages.title: Superconducting Coil Block
pages.text: A drum of superconducting coil wound around spacetime casing. Current, once started, circulates in it forever with no loss at all. The field it makes tugs gently at anything metal nearby. Frost gathers along the windings, a reminder of how cold the wire must stay.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Large machines needed strong, steady fields. Winding superconducting coil around spacetime casing gave me a coil that carries current indefinitely without heating, and a magnetic field that never flags.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronosteel Coil Block, Dipole Bending Magnet, Femtoscale Assembly Line, Neutrino Condenser, Plasma Crucible Casing, Plasma Injection Nozzle, Quark-Gluon Collider.
